name: README demo reproduces the blocking counterexample
description: Runs the default README patch through the live OMEN workflow.
steps: Confirm the OMEN logo and Security patch review screen are visible
expected: The visible expired-session test is PASS, Hidden probe · revoked session is FAIL, observed response is 200, expected response is 401, the audit trace is populated, and the final decision is DO NOT MERGE.

name: Remediated patch changes the executed result
description: Confirms the verdict changes because the candidate behavior changes.
expected: The visible test and revoked-session probe both show PASS and the final decision is SAFE TO MERGE.

name: Unsupported input does not manufacture evidence
description: Confirms OMEN preserves missing evidence when the patch cannot be applied.
steps: Replace the candidate patch with unrelated text
expected: The result is ASK CLARIFYING QUESTION and no invented test observations are shown.

name: Backend failure is visible
description: Confirms the page does not leave stale evidence on screen after a failed evaluation.
expected: Evaluation failed. Run it again. is visible.
